group_b.payout_notes: Death benefit can be paid as a lump sum or in instalments as per the death benefit instalment option. No survival or maturity benefit is payable as it is a pure term assurance plan.

derivation_notes.concern_tag_reasoning: As a standalone term assurance plan providing death benefits (with lump sum and instalment options), it serves as a tool for income replacement and estate/legacy protection for dependents in the case of untimely death. It does not build savings or provide retirement/investment returns.
